take.title_zh: AI 設計工具融合進入「雙向橋接」時代
take.title_en: AI Design Tools Enter the Bidirectional Bridge Era
take.body_zh:
OpenAI 與 Figma 的 Codex 深度整合，標誌著 AI 輔助設計進入新階段：設計稿可以直接生成可執行程式碼，程式碼也能反向轉為 Figma 設計文件。這不再只是「AI 幫你改顏色」，而是讓設計師與工程師的協作流程從根本上重塑——設計即原型，原型即產品。

與此同時，六月份的 AI 模型發布潮讓選擇工具本身變成了一門學問。當 NVIDIA、Google、阿里等廠商密集推出新模型，如何在海量選項中找到真正契合自身工作流的工具，成為設計師和 PM 當前最需要建立的判斷框架。
take.body_en:
OpenAI and Figma's Codex integration marks a new phase in AI-assisted design: Figma files now generate executable code, and code flows back into Figma as editable designs. This isn't just AI-assisted styling — it fundamentally reshapes designer-engineer collaboration, collapsing the distance between prototype and product.

Meanwhile, June 2026's AI model release wave — NVIDIA, Google, Alibaba's Qwen, and others shipping simultaneously — turns tool selection itself into a core competency. Knowing which model fits your workflow, not just which benchmarks are highest, is the judgment framework designers and PMs most urgently need right now.

articles.title_zh: OpenAI × Figma：Codex 打通程式碼與設計的雙向通道
articles.title_en: OpenAI and Figma Launch Code-to-Design Integration via Codex
articles.summary_zh: OpenAI 與 Figma 宣布深化合作，推出以 Codex 為核心的雙向整合：開發者可在 Codex 中直接生成 Figma 設計稿，設計師則可將 Figma 檔案一鍵轉換為可執行程式碼。這項整合讓設計稿不再只是靜態規格，而成為可直接接入開發流程的動態資產。對 PM 與設計師而言，與工程師的交接成本大幅降低；對開發者來說，原型到實作的距離也前所未有地縮短了。
articles.summary_en: OpenAI and Figma have deepened their partnership with a Codex-powered bidirectional integration. Developers can now generate Figma design files directly from Codex prompts, while designers can convert Figma projects into production-ready code in a single step. The integration fundamentally changes what a design file means — it is no longer a static specification but a live development asset connected directly to the engineering pipeline, dramatically reducing handoff friction between design and engineering teams.
articles.take_zh: Codex＋Figma 的雙向橋接是 AI 進入設計工作流最具實質意義的一步：當設計稿本身就能生成程式碼，「交接」這個環節將逐漸從工作流中消失。
articles.take_en: Codex bridging Figma bidirectionally may be the most structurally significant AI move in product design yet — when a design file generates code directly, the handoff phase starts to disappear from the workflow entirely.

articles.title_zh: 六月 AI 發布潮：給開發者的模型選擇決策地圖
articles.title_en: June 2026 AI Launch Wave: A Builder's Decision Map
articles.summary_zh: 六月 AI 發布浪潮中，NVIDIA、Google、阿里 Qwen 等多家廠商密集推出新模型，讓「選哪個」成為真正的難題。WaveSpeed 分析各主流模型的能力差異與適用場景，以「任務類型→延遲需求→成本上限」為主軸提出選模框架，協助開發者與設計師在海量選項中快速找到最適合自身工作流的工具，避免追逐 benchmark 卻忽略實際適用性的常見陷阱。
articles.summary_en: With NVIDIA, Google, Alibaba's Qwen, and multiple other labs flooding June 2026 with new model releases, choosing the right AI tool has become genuinely difficult. WaveSpeed maps each model's strengths against specific use-case types, latency requirements, and cost ceilings — offering builders a practical decision framework to match models to actual workflows, rather than defaulting to whatever tops the latest benchmark.
articles.take_zh: 當 AI 模型每兩天就出一個，挑選本身就成了技能。這份決策框架提醒我們：benchmark 不等於適用性，工作流契合度才是選型的真正標準。
articles.take_en: When models ship every two days, selection itself becomes a skill worth developing. This decision map is a useful reminder that benchmark rankings don't equal workflow fit — the most powerful model isn't always the right one for your team.

articles.title_zh: AI Flash Report：六月 LLM 新模型即時追蹤
articles.title_en: AI Flash Report: New AI Model Releases — June 2026 Tracker
articles.summary_zh: AI Flash Report 即時追蹤 2026 年六月的 LLM 發布動態。近期重要上線包括 NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Ultra 550B（6 月 4 日）、Google Gemma 4 12B 及 Alibaba Qwen3.7 Plus，三者分別代表超大參數開放模型、輕量可微調模型與多語言商業模型三條不同路線。AI 模型發布節奏已加速到約每 2 天一個新模型，對各類應用開發者形成持續選型壓力。
articles.summary_en: AI Flash Report tracks June 2026's rapid LLM release cycle, where new models arrive roughly every two days. Recent notable launches include NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Ultra 550B (June 4), Google Gemma 4 12B, and Alibaba Qwen3.7 Plus — representing three distinct tracks: massive open-weight, lightweight fine-tunable, and multilingual commercial. The tracker also monitors upcoming releases from Anthropic, OpenAI, and xAI.
articles.take_zh: 模型發布密度已逼近「難以追蹤」的臨界點。對設計師與 PM 而言，更重要的不是「跟上」，而是建立快速評估新模型是否影響自己工作流的篩選標準。
articles.take_en: Release density has hit a pace that's nearly impossible to track. For designers and PMs, building a filter for which models actually affect your workflow matters far more than keeping up.

articles.title_zh: Figma 六月更新：Tab 群組管理與 Check Designs 設計 QA
articles.title_en: Figma June 2026: Tab Groups and Check Designs for Design System QA
articles.summary_zh: Figma 桌面版新增 Tab 群組功能，讓使用者以色彩標記、展開/收合方式組織標籤頁，改善多專案並行效率。全新「Check Designs」功能在設計稿中自動掃描 design token 偏差、可及性對比不足、Library 不匹配及脫離元件問題，並提供一鍵修正建議，大幅降低設計師與開發者之間的 QA 成本，讓設計系統維護從手動審查走向自動化。
articles.summary_en: Figma's desktop app now supports tab groups, allowing users to color-code, expand, and collapse tabs for managing multiple projects simultaneously. The new Check Designs feature automatically scans open files for design token drift, accessibility contrast failures, library mismatches, and detached components, surfacing one-click fix suggestions inline. Together, these updates push design system quality control from manual visual review toward automated, systematic QA.
articles.take_zh: Check Designs 把設計系統的 QA 從「靠人眼盯」變成「自動掃描＋一鍵修復」——對維護嚴格設計語言的產品團隊而言，這是真正的工作流升級。
articles.take_en: Check Designs moves design system QA from manual eye-checking to fully automated scanning with one-click fixes — a genuinely useful upgrade for any team maintaining a strict design language at scale.

articles.title_zh: Figma AI 2026 全解析：能做什麼、還做不到什麼
articles.title_en: Figma AI in 2026: Everything It Can Do — and What It Still Can't
articles.summary_zh: LogRocket 系統盤點 Figma AI 在 2026 年的完整能力圖譜，涵蓋內容生成、AI 圖片編輯（由 Gemini 3.0 Pro 與 GPT Image 驅動）、智慧搜尋、UI 草稿生成、程式碼交接與全站生成。文章同時直指 Figma AI 仍無法解決的問題——複雜互動邏輯、精準品牌一致性控制及大型設計系統的自動化管理——給出平衡務實的評估，值得所有設計師收藏。
articles.summary_en: LogRocket maps Figma AI's complete 2026 capability set: content generation, AI image editing (Gemini 3.0 Pro and GPT Image), smart search, UI drafting, code handoff, and full-site creation. The article also honestly flags what Figma AI still can't handle — complex interaction logic, precise brand consistency control, and large-scale design system automation — making it a balanced, practically useful reference for any working designer.
articles.take_zh: 這篇的價值不在能力列表，而在「它還不行的地方」——清楚知道邊界，才能在工作流中正確使用 AI 工具，而不是期待它做到它做不到的事。
articles.take_en: The real value here is the 'what it can't do' section — knowing the limits clearly is what lets you deploy AI tools correctly, not expecting more than they can deliver.

articles.title_zh: AI News 六月 2026：IPO 準備、模型競賽與產業轉型
articles.title_en: AI News — June 2026: IPO Moves, Model Race, and Industry Shifts
articles.summary_zh: 六月 AI 產業動態彙整：OpenAI 正式啟動 IPO 準備程序，估值達 7,300 億美元，最快九月掛牌；各大實驗室模型發布持續密集；AI 監管與政策討論同步升溫。這些事件合計標誌著 AI 產業從「技術競賽」轉向「資本化與商業成熟」的重要節點，也預示著下半年產業格局將出現結構性變化。
articles.summary_en: June 2026 AI industry roundup: OpenAI has reportedly begun confidential IPO filings at a $730B private valuation, targeting a public listing as early as September 2026. Multi-lab model releases continue at a dense pace, and AI policy and regulatory conversations are intensifying globally. Together, these developments mark the industry's pivotal transition from pure technical competition into a phase of capitalization and commercial maturity.
articles.take_zh: OpenAI IPO 傳言成真——$730B 估值與九月時程，讓 AI 產業正式進入資本市場主導的敘事新章，對整個生態系的走向影響深遠。
articles.take_en: OpenAI's IPO preparations at a $730B valuation make it official: AI has entered a capital-markets-driven narrative — with meaningful downstream effects on funding models, product priorities, and how the entire ecosystem develops.
